append.detail: ROOT CAUSE 2026-10-12 (second pass, read from production after #3383 deployed). A repeat anonymous view with the whole cookie jar retained was still MISS with private, no-store, while /events/<slug> answered PRERENDER with a public cache-control, and the build table marks /market/[id], /store/[id], /housing/[id] and /classifieds/[id] as dynamic. The difference is generateStaticParams: Next 16's generate-static-params.md says a dynamic route revalidates (ISR) at runtime only when generateStaticParams exists (an empty list is enough), and those four pages were the only sitemap-advertised details without one. Each now exports generateStaticParams returning [], so every path is generated on its first visit and cached; lib/nav/public-detail-isr.test.ts and the LIVE-884 probe require it on every ISR-intended public detail. The capture script now retains the whole cookie jar between the first and repeat view.
